review_scope: Selected primary abstracts, method/conclusion sections and attributed textbook passages; not an exhaustive systematic review or a reproduction of every method.

papers.title: Nougat: Neural Optical Understanding for Academic Documents
papers.claim: Preserve semantic document structure, not OCR text alone.
papers.limitations: Nougat is not installed; our current repair is source inspection plus deterministic checks.

papers.title: BEA 2024: Automated Prediction of Difficulty and Response Time
papers.claim: Evaluate difficulty predictions against observed responses.
papers.limitations: Medical-item results do not establish GMAT difficulty validity.

papers.title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning through Multiagent Debate
papers.claim: Independent answers followed by reasoned exchanges are an experimental condition.
papers.limitations: B2 runner exists; no completed cross-model B2 result is recorded.

papers.title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
papers.claim: Extract reusable lessons from checked experience without changing weights.
papers.limitations: Our adapted E1 memory produced no accuracy gain; this is not a faithful reproduction of ExpeL.

papers.title: Dynamic Cheatsheet: Test-Time Learning with Adaptive Memory
papers.claim: Store reusable experience outside model weights.
papers.limitations: Our static subtype rules differ from an evolving cheatsheet; generated-question improvement is unmeasured.

papers.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
papers.claim: Measure harmful as well as helpful revisions; external evidence matters.
papers.limitations: Older models and tested tasks do not prove all modern self-correction fails.

papers.title: Let’s Verify Step by Step
papers.claim: Evaluate reasoning steps in addition to final answer letters.
papers.limitations: Mathematical process reward models are not implemented here; CR explanations remain unrated.

papers.title: Distractor generation with predictive prompting and LLMs
papers.claim: Retrieve suitable examples and evaluate distractors with expert judgments.
papers.limitations: Ranked example retrieval and teacher-rated distractor evaluation remain unimplemented. E2 v2 tests a procedure scaffold, not this paper’s retrieval method.

papers.title: Generative Students: LLM-Simulated Student Profiles
papers.claim: Simulated learners can be a preliminary item diagnostic.
papers.limitations: Simulation cannot replace real learner outcomes; no simulation efficacy result is recorded.

papers.title: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers
papers.claim: Test whether raw examples and condensed lessons causally affect decisions.
papers.limitations: Selected full-text findings reviewed: condensed experience may be ignored. Our rules-versus-raw-example causal ablation has not been run; a memory store alone is not evidence of learning.

papers.title: Deep Knowledge Tracing
papers.claim: Validate learner-state estimates by future response prediction.
papers.limitations: DKT is not implemented; current service uses Elo and recommendation rules.

papers.title: ReviewFast: decision ranking with auditable screening
papers.claim: Separate ranking criteria, model scores, final decisions and audit records.
papers.limitations: Literature relevance is not learning gain; Jev is not used in Questionize.

papers.title: Fundamental Methods of Logic — Matthew Knachel (2017 original)
papers.claim: Argument analysis, relevance, causality and counterexample procedures motivate explicit design checks.
papers.limitations: Selected primary passages reviewed; adapted method candidate, not GMAT answer-key evidence or a faithful research-paper reproduction. C5 comparison is an AI proxy; human ratings remain absent.

papers.title: forall x: Calgary — Fall 2025
papers.claim: Distinguish validity from plausibility, use counterexamples, and separate necessary from sufficient conditions.
papers.limitations: Selected sections reviewed, textbook and solutions archived locally. Candidate context integration is implemented; no measured improvement is attributed to this reference.

knowledge_policy.expert_reference: Original publisher/teacher evidence and model-extracted derivatives stay private with source hashes and separate lineage. Model extraction is never labeled expert authorship.

knowledge_policy.promotion: AI agreement cannot confirm a label or change a knowledge origin. Retrieval must choose an origin explicitly.
knowledge_policy.rights: Expert-reference observations cannot fan out to the public Bank. Only separately cleared abstracts can be shared.
